beats.event: Vladimir and Estragon meet by a leafless tree, waiting
Estragon reports another night in a ditch, beaten
It emerges they are waiting for a man named Godot
They cannot recall if they have ever met Godot
Pozzo arrives leading Lucky on a rope
Watch Pozzo drive Lucky as a beast of burden
Pozzo is on his way to sell Lucky at the market
Lucky performs his manic monologue on command
Pozzo and Lucky depart; the two go on waiting
A boy: Godot won't come tonight, surely tomorrow
They agree to leave, but do not move
Act II: same tree, now with a few leaves; waiting again
Pozzo returns blind; Lucky wholly mute
Pozzo has no memory of ever meeting them
Boy returns: Godot again won't come tonight
Boy denies ever having met them before
They consider hanging themselves but have no rope
Agree to return with a rope; remain motionless
